proposal.reactor_type: 10 mL FEP photocoil, 1.0 mm ID, 420 nm compatible
proposal.residence_time_basis: Pressure-corrected total in-channel volumetric flow at the nominal downstream BPR pressure. The 5 barg BPR is treated as 6.013 bara at 21 C; the gas flow is corrected from STP to this pressure and temperature. This is an estimated hydrodynamic residence time and may increase upstream of the BPR or change if appreciable air dissolves.
proposal.light_setup: Irradiate the full 10 mL coil with the listed 420 nm LED in the listed coil-compatible configuration. The available source is specified as 20 W and 100 mW cm^-2; use the stated 420 nm setting and do not infer equivalence to the batch lamp power because illuminated geometry is not supplied.

streams.contents: Fmoc-L-methionine (0.100 M, 1.00 equiv) and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole (0.010 M, 0.10 equiv)
Air, selected to reproduce the oxidant identity of the supplied batch protocol
streams.molar_equiv: 4.46 mol air per mol substrate by molar feed; estimated 0.93 mol O2 per mol substrate if air contains 20.95 mol% O2

proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: First establish the liquid reagent/catalyst stream, then introduce air through the certified T-mixer immediately upstream of the illuminated coil. This minimizes unirradiated gas-liquid hold-up while providing segmented flow and continuous air renewal. Air is selected rather than pure oxygen because the parent batch protocol was explicitly exposed to air.
pre_reactor_steps: Prepare one homogeneous acetonitrile solution containing 0.100 M Fmoc-L-methionine and 0.010 M photocatalyst; no degassing is performed.
Connect liquid stream L1 and gas stream G1 to the certified gas-liquid T-mixer, followed by the 10 mL photocoil and then the 5 barg BPR.
Start L1 at 0.500 mL/min, establish the BPR-controlled outlet path, then start air at 5.00 sccm STP.
Once stable segmented flow is observed at the outlet, turn on the 420 nm LED. Treat the first three estimated in-channel residence times as equilibration material.
post_reactor_steps: Maintain irradiation and collect material only after at least 21.3 min of stable operation, corresponding to three estimated 7.10 min in-channel reactor volumes.
Collect a subsequent 7.10 min steady-state fraction for offline product/yield assessment against Fmoc-methionine sulfoxide.
At shutdown, turn off irradiation, stop the air feed, and then stop the liquid feed after the pressurized flow path has been managed according to the laboratory's approved pressure-release procedure.
proposal.chemistry_notes: The parent batch result used 0.100 M substrate, 10 mol% photocatalyst, air exposure, 420 nm-region irradiation, 21 C, and 5 min exposure. This screen preserves concentration, catalyst loading, oxidant identity, temperature target, and excitation window. The estimated 7.10 min pressure-corrected coil residence is deliberately modestly longer than the reported 5 min batch irradiation to allow for uncertain gas-liquid mass transfer and nonidentical photon geometry. No claim is made that air oxidation stoichiometry or photon flux is quantitatively identical to batch.

reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.100 M matches the supplied batch concentration; catalyst concentration is therefore 0.010 M at 10 mol%.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: 0.500 mL/min is within the listed syringe-pump range of 0.01-5.0 mL/min and gives a substrate feed of 0.050 mmol/min.
reasoning_per_field.gas_flow: The 5.00 sccm air inlet flow is within the MFC range of 0.1-100 sccm. At 21 C and assumed 6.013 bara, Qgas = 5.00 x (294.15/273.15) x (1.01325/6.01325) = 0.907 mL/min in-channel. The inlet/STP gas flow and pressure-corrected in-channel gas flow are intentionally reported separately.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time: At the BPR pressure, total estimated in-channel flow is 0.500 + 0.907 = 1.407 mL/min, giving 10.0/1.407 = 7.10 min. The inlet/STP nominal-volume comparison is 10.0/(0.500 + 5.00) = 1.82 min and is not the physical pressurized-coil residence time.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: A 5 barg setpoint is below the 20 bar ratings stated for the pump, gas hardware, and FEP tubing. The calculation assumes the stated BPR value is gauge pressure; if it is an absolute-pressure setting, the in-channel gas volume and residence-time estimate must be recalculated.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_and_light: The listed 10 mL, 1.0 mm-ID FEP photocoil is compatible with the listed 420 nm LED. The 420 nm wavelength satisfies the required 410-430 nm window and matches the parent protocol's excitation region.

proposal.literature_analogies: The sole chemistry precedent used is the supplied parent batch protocol: Fmoc-L-methionine oxidation with 10 mol% 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole in MeCN under air and approximately 420 nm irradiation. No unprovided external literature performance has been assumed.
safety_flags: Pressurized gas-liquid operation: place the BPR downstream of the photocoil, verify all connections are rated for the intended pressure, and do not exceed the listed 20 bar component limits.

The design uses air rather than enriched oxygen to remain closer to the batch precedent and reduce oxidizer severity; nonetheless, avoid ignition sources around the air feed and illuminated apparatus.
Acetonitrile-containing liquid should be handled in an appropriate ventilated setup with compatible waste collection.
Photochemical operation: shield the 420 nm LED/coil assembly from direct viewing and minimize exposure to emitted light.
Do not assume the coil remains at 21 C solely because the batch reaction was at 21 C; LED heating and absorption can change the actual reaction temperature.
Gas solubility, pressure drop, and slug-flow regime can alter the actual residence time and oxygen availability; this is why the recommendation is SCREEN rather than EXECUTE.

confidence.basis: Hardware, wavelength, pressure, flow-range, concentration, and volumetric calculations are consistent with the supplied inventory and constraints.
confidence.main_uncertainties: Actual coil pressure profile, air dissolution and mass transfer, illuminated reactor geometry, temperature under the 20 W LED, and the reaction's oxygen demand are not specified by the frozen input.
